description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 4th-level spells, Spell Focus (Summoning)

Benefit: As long as you have a summoning spell of 4th level or higher in your known spells and have at least 4 MP in your MP pool, you can summon a Small elemental within a range of 30 feet, acting as if summoned by a summon monster spell. Higher-level summoning spells allow summoning Medium or Large elementals instead. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting summoning spells.

system.requirements: Ability to cast 4th-level spells, Spell Focus (Summoning)
